TITLE: WPEG.app: Free Invoice Generator
CANONICAL URL: https://invoice.wpeg.app/
DESCRIPTION: Free, client-side, privacy-focused invoice generator built for Winnipeg small businesses, contractors, and freelancers.

CORE ATTRIBUTES:
- Privacy: 100% Client-Side. No personal data, client information, or invoice totals are ever sent to or stored on remote servers.
- Cost: 100% Free Forever with no subscriptions, credit cards, or accounts required.
- Templates: 10 professionally designed PDF invoice templates (Classic, Modern, Professional, Minimalist, Elegant, CXO, Creative, Brutalist, Pastel, Eco).
- Regional Focus: Built-in tax rate presets for Manitoba (12% GST+PST, 5% GST, and tax-exempt).
- Features: Instant PDF generation, live browser preview with mobile/tablet view modes, company logo uploads, line item calculations, local storage persistence.

KEY URLS:
- Home: https://invoice.wpeg.app/
- Invoice Creator & Dashboard: https://invoice.wpeg.app/dashboard
- Public Changelog: https://invoice.wpeg.app/changelog
- RSS Feed: https://invoice.wpeg.app/changelog/rss
- Terms & Disclaimer: https://invoice.wpeg.app/terms
- Sitemap: https://invoice.wpeg.app/sitemap.xml
